description: Swipe from one point to another (scrolling, dismissing). For drag-and-drop use drag instead. Instead of pixels you can pass screen percentages (0-1): safer when estimating positions from a screenshot image.

serial.description: Device serial (defaults to session or the only device)

x1Pct.description: Start X as fraction of width (0-1)

x2Pct.description: End X as fraction of width (0-1)

y1Pct.description: Start Y as fraction of height (0-1)

y2Pct.description: End Y as fraction of height (0-1)

name: swipe
title: Swipe
